# XMP import contract fixtures

These ten small XMP files were hand-authored with synthetic settings. They validate parsing and numeric mappings and contain no customer files.

The four hand-authored partial darktable histories exercise refusal of incomplete histories. New darktable imports require the complete qualified native history rather than mapping a few controls into approximate pixels. Historical opaque version 1 recipes remain preserved.

The hand-authored fixtures do not qualify visual equivalence. The additional three `darktable-native-*.xmp` histories and `*-native-reference.jpg` files are independently generated native darktable fixtures; their source, license, immutable pixel provenance and precise qualification boundary are recorded in [SOURCE.md](./SOURCE.md). No Lightroom reference or owner aesthetic acceptance is implied.
